app.name: NTD-WATCH
app.subtitle: Community Health Intelligence
app.tagline: From community signals to timely public-health action.

banner.demo: NTD-WATCH is an internal functional prototype. This demonstration uses synthetic data and illustrative rules. It demonstrates a proposed community-to-action workflow and is not a clinically validated or production system. Every record is synthetic.
banner.auth: Simulated login and roles. Not security controls.
banner.resetConfirm: Reset all demo records, queue and views to the start?
banner.short: Internal functional prototype using synthetic data and illustrative rules. Every record is synthetic. Not a clinically validated or production system.

landing.what: A community-level digital system that captures NTD-related symptoms and contextual risk factors, assesses potential risk using demonstration rules, supports referral and follow-up, and turns anonymised community data into GIS-based intelligence for health programmes.
landing.notDiagnosis: NTD-WATCH supports early recognition, triage, referral and programme decisions. It does not diagnose disease.
landing.chwBody: Mobile-first workflow: assess, see a demonstration risk result, refer, follow up.
landing.progBody: Responsive web dashboard for facility, LGA and state users, and the administrator.
landing.limitsTitle: What this prototype does not do

limits.outbreak: Declare outbreaks. Signals are investigation triggers.
limits.validated: Apply validated clinical rules. All rules are demonstration-only.
limits.real: Hold real patient data. All data is synthetic.
limits.integrations: Connect to DHIS2 or other systems.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in to the community health worker app.
login.who: You will be signed in as {{label}}.
login.pinHint: Any 4 digits. It is not checked against anything.

start.privacy: No names, phone numbers or addresses are collected. An assessment code is created so you can find the person in your own records.

start.draftFound: You have an assessment in progress (code {{code}}).

context.animalContact: Has the person had close contact with livestock or other animals?
context.insectBites: Has the person had many insect or fly bites?
context.householdSimilar: Do others in the household or neighbourhood have similar signs?

wash.handwashing: Is there a place to wash hands with water and soap at home?
wash.standingWater: Is there standing water near the home?

result.referralOptional: A referral is optional for this demonstration result.

followup.attendedFacility: Did the person attend the health facility?
followup.further: You said a further referral is needed.
followup.notFound: That assessment is not on this device.

history.empty: No assessments saved on this device yet.

profile.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting. Every saved change has been sent.
profile.simBody: These switches exist so offline and error behaviour can be demonstrated. They are not part of a real product.

programme.demoRules: Risk levels come from demonstration rules that are not clinically validated. Nothing here is a diagnosis or a confirmed case.
programme.scopeLine: Your simulated data scope: {{scope}}. Scope is simulated and is not a security control.
programme.errorBody: The mock server did not respond as expected.
programme.emptyBody: Widen the date range or clear a geographic filter. Records appear here after assessments are entered in the CHW app and synchronised.

filters.title: Filters
filters.dateRequired: Enter both a start date and an end date.
filters.dateOrder: The start date must be on or before the end date.

community.title: Community details
community.aggregateOnly: Aggregated synthetic summary. Person-level records are not available in this view.
community.noChw: No community health worker is assigned to this community in the demonstration data, so there are no assessments. This is a coverage gap.
community.noData: No assessments in the selected period.

overview.title: Programme overview
overview.lead: Aggregated, synthetic intelligence from community assessments, referrals and follow-ups.
overview.provenanceBody: This prototype uses synthetic data for demonstration and testing. Figures may include generated baseline records and records created during this demo. They do not represent verified real-world cases or validated programme performance.
overview.provenanceCounts: Assessments in this view: {{seeded}} generated baseline records and {{live}} demo-created assessments.
overview.provenanceNote: Demo-created assessments are records created through the demonstration workflow in this browser and received by the mock server. They are synthetic demonstration records, not verified real-world cases. Records still waiting to sync are not counted yet. If any such record cannot be verified as a demonstration record, the small-count rule hides this figure instead. Referral and follow-up provenance is not summarised here.
overview.signalShare: {{share}} of assessments are HIGH or URGENT
overview.unresolvedHint: Not assessed within the allowed days
overview.unclassified: Assessments that could not be classified (not enough data): {{count}}.
overview.hiddenSignals: {{count}} communities have a signal count that is not shown (small-count rule). They are not ranked above and are not zero.
overview.noSignals: No HIGH or URGENT assessments in this period.
overview.attentionNote: Rising means the last 28 days have clearly more signals than the 28 before. It is a demonstration heuristic, not an outbreak alert.
overview.followUpsDueHint: Assessed referrals still waiting for a community follow-up

gis.title: GIS map
gis.lead: Fictional map of communities. Two separate layers: demonstration risk signals and WASH and environment vulnerability.
gis.legendSignals: count of HIGH or URGENT assessments
gis.noMapTitle: The map cannot be drawn here
gis.noMapBody: This browser cannot draw the map (it needs WebGL). The table below has the same information and works the same way.
gis.labelsHidden: Names hidden on the map to avoid overlap: {{count}}. Select a community, or use the table below, which lists every community.
gis.selectPrompt: Select a community on the map, or use the table, to see its synthetic summary.
gis.tableLead: The same information as the map, as a table.

signals.title: Risk signals
signals.lead: Where demonstration risk assessments are concentrated, and where they are changing.
signals.byCommunity: HIGH and URGENT assessments by community
signals.indicatorsNote: How often each symptom was recorded across all assessments in the selected view.
signals.directionNote: Direction compares the last 28 days of the selected range with the 28 days before. It is a demonstration heuristic.

vulnerability.title: Community vulnerability
vulnerability.lead: WASH and environment vulnerability computed from assessment answers.
vulnerability.noIndex: No index for {{names}}: fewer than {{min}} assessments, or too few known answers.
vulnerability.method: The index is the mean share of households with an unimproved water source, no sanitation, no handwashing and standing water nearby, from 0 to 100. Bands (moderate from {{moderate}}, higher from {{high}}) are demonstration thresholds, not validated cut-offs.

referrals.title: Referral monitoring
referrals.lead: How referrals move from generated to assessed and followed up.
referrals.aggregateOnly: Counts only. This view never lists a person or an individual referral.
referrals.facilityOnly: Showing referrals sent to your own facility only.
referrals.reachedNote: Each bar counts referrals that reached this stage or a later one.
referrals.ageingNote: Referrals not yet assessed, by days since they were generated. The allowed time is {{days}} days.
referrals.currentStageNote: Stage columns show the current stage of each referral.

trends.title: Trends
trends.lead: Weekly movement in assessments, signals, referrals and vulnerability.
trends.mixTitle: Weekly assessments by demonstration risk level
trends.partialWeek: The first and last weeks may be partial, depending on the date range.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Aggregated reports for the current filters. Every export is labelled as synthetic demonstration data.
reports.generated: {{title}} generated. It is labelled as synthetic demonstration data.
reports.auditFailed: The report is ready, but the mock server could not log it: {{reason}}

users.title: User management
users.lead: Synthetic users, roles and scopes. Super Administrator only.
users.simulated: Roles, permissions and this directory are simulated. Changes here are stored in the browser's mock server only and do not protect anything.
users.protected: The Super Administrator account cannot be demoted or disabled.
users.matrixNote: Programme roles hold no person-level permission. Only CHWs and facility workers can reach person-level records.

settings.title: Settings
settings.rulesReadOnly: The rules are data and are documented in docs/RULES.md. Editing or validating rules needs expert review and approval and is not part of this prototype.
settings.unresolvedDays: Days before an unassessed referral counts as unresolved
settings.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 30.
settings.serverDownNote: While this is on, programme views show their error state and CHW synchronisation is queued and retried.
settings.resetNote: Resetting clears every record held by the mock server and every record on this device, then regenerates the synthetic seed.
settings.resetConfirm: This deletes records entered in the CHW app on this browser. Continue?
settings.governanceNote: Every rule is shown with its identity, version and review state. All rules are placeholders: none has a source protocol, a named owner or a validation record. A real programme would assign these before use. This table is read only.

gov.description: What it says when it fires
gov.noOwner: Not assigned (to be named by the programme)

settings.capabilityTitle: What is real, simulated or future
settings.capabilityNote: Every capability in this demo carries one label. REAL means it works in this prototype on synthetic data. It does not mean production-ready or clinically valid. SIMULATED means a mock or a seed stands in. FUTURE means it is not built and needs validation or a decision first.

programme.smallCountNote: "n/s" means not shown. A count of 1 to 4 is not shown, to protect small groups, and a figure that would let a hidden count be worked out by subtraction is also not shown, so n/s is never zero and is not always small. This is a prototype display rule, not a security control.
programme.noComparison: No comparison: too little data in the previous period

inbox.title: Facility referral inbox
inbox.lead: Referrals sent to your facility by community health workers. Move each one forward as the person is received, assessed and the outcome is recorded.
inbox.scopeNote: Simulated facility workflow using synthetic demonstration data. It shows only referrals sent to your own simulated facility, and it is the only programme page that shows person-level synthetic records. Access control here is simulated. No real facility receives or processes these referrals.
inbox.updated: Referral moved to “{{stage}}”. This was a simulated facility update on synthetic data. The community health worker sees it after pressing “Refresh status” on their referral page.
inbox.empty: No referrals have been sent to this facility yet
inbox.noneOpen: No open referrals. Choose “All referrals” to see closed ones.
inbox.notClinical: The risk signal is a non-diagnostic prompt from demonstration rules that are not clinically validated. The outcome you record is a synthetic category, not a clinical record.
inbox.finished: This referral is closed. Nothing more to do.

priority.title: Priority communities
priority.lead: Where should attention go first, and why? Each community combines the NTD signal layer with the community vulnerability layer.
priority.notOutbreak: A priority category is a prompt for a human decision about where to look first. It does not declare an outbreak, confirm cases or recommend treatment. Bands and categories are demonstration settings that are not validated.
priority.matrixNote: Only a higher band counts as high. Signal is high when at least {{signalHigh}}% of assessments were rated HIGH or URGENT by the demonstration rules. Vulnerability is high at an index of {{vulnHigh}} or more. Select a cell to filter the table.
priority.insufficient: Communities without enough assessments to be placed: {{count}}.
priority.filterOpen: Only with open referrals or follow-ups
priority.why: Why this community is placed here
